summary.en: The Hang Seng Index plunged 640 points (2.6%) to 23,972 on the first trading day of October, diverging from US stocks which rose across the board. Financial Secretary Paul Chan said in his blog that US long-term bond yields hitting 24-year highs worried investors about the global economic outlook, weighing on Hong Kong stocks. He also noted average daily turnover rose 6.4% in the first nine months and 116 new listings raised over HK$388 billion.
summary.zh_hans: 恒指在10月首个交易日泻640点（2.6%）收报23,972点，与同日全线上升的美股背驰。财政司司长陈茂波在网志表示，美长债息率升至24年高位，令投资者担忧全球经济前景，影响港股表现。他又指本港首九个月日均成交额上升6.4%，116间新上市公司集资逾3,880亿港元。
summary.zh_hant: 恒指在10月首個交易日瀉640點（2.6%）收報23,972點，與同日全線上升的美股背馳。財政司司長陳茂波在網誌表示，美長債息率升至24年高位，令投資者擔憂全球經濟前景，影響港股表現。他又指本港首九個月日均成交額上升6.4%，116間新上市公司集資逾3,880億港元。

title.en: Hang Seng plunges 640 points as US stocks rally; Paul Chan blames US bond yield concerns

summary.en: The Immigration Department expects today to be the peak land-crossing inbound day of the National Day golden week, with around 586,000 inbound trips forecast. As of 10am, control points recorded about 184,737 passenger movements, including 102,886 arrivals. More than 221,000 mainland visitors arrived yesterday.
summary.zh_hans: 入境处预料今日是十一黄金周的陆路入境高峰，全日预计约58.6万人次入境。截至上午10时，各管制站录得约18.5万人次出入境，其中入境约10.3万人次。昨日则有逾22万内地旅客到港。
summary.zh_hant: 入境處預料今日是十一黃金周的陸路入境高峰，全日預計約58.6萬人次入境。截至上午10時，各管制站錄得約18.5萬人次出入境，其中入境約10.3萬人次。昨日則有逾22萬內地旅客到港。

title.en: Golden week: today expected to be peak land-crossing inbound day, 100,000 arrivals by 10am

summary.en: After Starbucks opened two new stores in Xinjiang on September 29, the chair of the US House Select Committee on China called the company 'morally bankrupt' and urged it to close the stores. China's Foreign Ministry responded on October 3, saying the so-called 'genocide' in Xinjiang is an outright lie.
summary.zh_hans: 星巴克9月29日在新疆新开两间门店后，美国众议院美中战略竞争特设委员会主席批评其「道德沦丧」并要求关店。中国外交部10月3日回应指，所谓新疆「种族灭绝」是赤裸裸的谎言。
summary.zh_hant: 星巴克9月29日在新疆新開兩間門店後，美國眾議院美中戰略競爭特設委員會主席批評其「道德淪喪」並要求關店。中國外交部10月3日回應指，所謂新疆「種族滅絕」是赤裸裸的謊言。

title.en: Starbucks criticized by US over Xinjiang stores; Foreign Ministry calls 'genocide' claims an outright lie

summary.en: Former Financial Secretary John Tsang wrote in support of fencer Cheung Ka-long, who faced criticism after being eliminated at the Asian Games. Tsang recalled how he was also mocked after winning a fencing championship in the US years ago, urging Cheung not to care what people say and to focus on training.
summary.zh_hans: 前财政司司长曾俊华发文，为在亚运出局后遭批评的剑击选手张家朗抱不平。他忆起自己多年前在美国参加击剑比赛夺冠亦曾遭取笑，勉励张家朗「唔驶理人咁多」，专心备战。

summary.en: Hong Kong Airlines flight HX676 from Hong Kong to Okinawa departed this morning but its landing gear was suspected of failing to retract after takeoff. The crew followed safety procedures and returned, landing safely at Hong Kong International Airport with no injuries. The 160 affected passengers have been rebooked on other flights.
summary.zh_hans: 香港航空HX676今早由香港飞往冲绳那霸，起飞后怀疑起落架未能收起，机师按安全程序折返，于早上安全降落香港国际机场，机上无人受伤。160名受影响旅客已获安排改乘其他航班。
summary.zh_hant: 香港航空HX676今早由香港飛往沖繩那霸，起飛後懷疑起落架未能收起，機師按安全程序折返，於早上安全降落香港國際機場，機上無人受傷。160名受影響旅客已獲安排改乘其他航班。

title.en: Hong Kong Airlines flight HX676 to Okinawa returns to Hong Kong after landing gear fails to retract

summary.en: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said the policy address proposal to trial the import of foreign home care workers with specialized elderly-care skills is expected to start in the second half of next year, initially bringing in several hundred people. Applicants must complete over 150 hours of training in their home countries, and their minimum wage will be 10 to 20 percent higher than current foreign domestic helpers.
summary.zh_hans: 劳工及福利局局长孙玉菡表示，施政报告提出试行输入具专项护老技能的外籍家居照顾员，预计明年下半年起试行，初期引入数百人。申请人须在原居地接受逾150小时培训，最低工资将较现时外佣高一至两成。
summary.zh_hant: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡表示，施政報告提出試行輸入具專項護老技能的外籍家居照顧員，預計明年下半年起試行，初期引入數百人。申請人須在原居地接受逾150小時培訓，最低工資將較現時外傭高一至兩成。

title.en: Foreign home care worker scheme to be trialled from second half of next year, says Sun

summary.en: Korean star Nana revealed in an interview that she cleared all her body tattoos with five laser sessions over ten months without any anesthetic cream, to save the three to four hours needed to apply it. She kept only a '1968' tattoo on her calf, her mother's birth year.
summary.zh_hans: 韩国艺人Nana受访时透露，为节省敷麻醉药所需的3至4小时，她在10个月内以5次激光疗程、不施麻醉药下洗去全身纹身，仅留下小腿上「1968」的纹身，那是母亲的出生年份。
summary.zh_hant: 韓國藝人Nana受訪時透露，為節省敷麻醉藥所需的3至4小時，她在10個月內以5次激光療程、不施麻醉藥下洗去全身紋身，僅留下小腿上「1968」的紋身，那是母親的出生年份。

summary.en: Kai Tak Hospital will begin its first-phase service on Monday (October 5), initially offering outpatient services including specialist clinics and day medical services. The hospital has published details on its service scope, appointment booking methods, and transport arrangements.
summary.zh_hans: 启德医院将于周一（10月5日）首阶段投入服务，首阶段主要提供门诊服务，包括专科门诊及日间医疗服务。医院方面已公布服务范围、预约方式及交通安排，方便市民求诊。

summary.en: The administrative accountability support panel set up after the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po will begin work this month, led by Choi Kin-bun and Mok Kwan-yu. It will investigate whether there were administrative failures in the fire response and submit a report to the Chief Executive.
summary.zh_hans: 大埔宏福苑火灾后成立的行政问责支援组本月正式埋班，由蔡健斌及莫君虞领导，调查火灾中是否存在行政失职，并撰写报告呈交行政长官。支援组将检视相关部门在火灾前后的处理，确保问责。
summary.zh_hant: 大埔宏福苑火災後成立的行政問責支援組本月正式埋班，由蔡健斌及莫君虞領導，調查火災中是否存在行政失職，並撰寫報告呈交行政長官。支援組將檢視相關部門在火災前後的處理，確保問責。

title.en: Wang Fuk Court fire accountability panel to start work this month; to report findings to Chief Executive

summary.en: Hong Kong Investment Corporation CEO Clara Chan said the company has invested in more than 200 projects cumulatively, of which 11 portfolio companies have listed in Hong Kong, and over 30 more plan to file for a Hong Kong listing this year. The portfolio's net internal rate of return reached 14% as of the end of last year.
summary.zh_hans: 港投公司行政总裁陈家齐表示，公司累计投资逾200个项目，其中已有11家被投企业在港上市，另有超过30家被投企业计划今年内提交在港上市申请。截至去年底，投资组合的净内部回报率达14%。

summary.en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in an interview that China's AI models have reached 80 to 90 percent of US capability. He revealed plans to propose a US-China AI safety notification mechanism so the two sides can share information on AI development and manage potential risks.

summary.en: Brazil held the first round of its presidential election today with 13 candidates in the race. Polls show incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, leading by a wide margin, though neither is expected to reach an outright majority, making a runoff likely.
summary.zh_hans: 巴西今日举行总统选举首轮投票，共有13名候选人竞逐。民调显示现任总统卢拉与前总统博尔索纳罗之子弗拉维奥支持度大幅领先，但两人均未过半，预料需要进入第二轮投票。

title.en: Brazil holds first-round presidential vote; Lula and Bolsonaro's son expected to advance to runoff

summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯总统普京表示，下月在深圳出席APEC领导人非正式会议期间将与国家主席习近平会晤。外交部发言人郭嘉昆回应，中方欢迎普京出席11月在深圳举行的APEC会议，愿与俄方共同推动APEC"中国年"取得丰硕成果。
summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯總統普京表示，下月在深圳出席APEC領導人非正式會議期間將與國家主席習近平會晤。外交部發言人郭嘉昆回應，中方歡迎普京出席11月在深圳舉行的APEC會議，願與俄方共同推動APEC「中國年」取得豐碩成果。

summary.zh_hans: 日本警方10月4日以涉嫌抢劫杀人罪，逮捕一名隶属美军普天间基地的上等兵。10月3日，那霸市一家酒店发生女性遇害案件，死者随身财物被抢走。

The drill reportedly used a hypersonic strategic weapons system to strike a target in the eastern waters, aimed at mastering firepower control.
summary.zh_hans: 朝鲜于10月3日凌晨在东部地区进行中程战略导弹发射训练，劳动党总书记金正恩亲临观摩指导。导弹命中设定于东部海域的目标，训练旨在令操作高超音速战略武器系统的导弹兵熟练掌握火力操纵能力。

title.en: Kim Jong Un oversees North Korea's medium-range strategic missile launch drill

summary.zh_hans: 文化体育及旅游局体育专员蔡健斌今日完成体育专员职务，周一（5日）起出任协助公务员叙用委员会调查宏福苑火灾行政责任的相关职务。其下属、文体旅局首席助理秘书长庄敏婷将接任体育专员。

summary.en: Over the past five days, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps navy has taken action against at least seven "non-compliant" oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian sources. The moves come despite US claims that the strait remains open and under American control.
summary.zh_hans: 据伊朗方面消息，过去5天内，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队海军在霍尔木兹海峡针对至少7艘"违规"油轮采取行动。尽管美国政府一直声称海峡保持开放并处于美方控制之下，伊方平均每天针对不止一艘油轮采取行动。
summary.zh_hant: 據伊朗方面消息，過去5天內，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊海軍在霍爾木茲海峽針對至少7艘「違規」油輪採取行動。儘管美國政府一直聲稱海峽保持開放並處於美方控制之下，伊方平均每天針對不止一艘油輪採取行動。

summary.en: The injured Indian captain of a flydubai flight, still hospitalised after a cockpit conflict, told Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu in a video call how he was repeatedly struck on the head by the co-pilot and managed to open the cockpit door so others could subdue the attacker.

summary.zh_hant: 迪拜航空客機駕駛艙衝突事件中受傷的印度籍機長馬查爾仍然留院，他與以色列總理內塔尼亞胡視像通話，憶述事發時副機長從後多次重擊其後腦，他用盡力氣打開駕駛艙門讓人進入協助制服疑犯。

summary.en: A JPMorgan research note says US tech stocks may have seen the worst of a months-long valuation compression, with the "Magnificent Seven" valuations at decade lows. The AI capital expenditure cycle is expected to continue, putting tech stocks back in focus, though the era of tech dominating market returns may be over.
summary.zh_hans: 摩根大通研报指，在历经长达数月的估值压缩后，美股科技股"最艰难的阶段或已过去"，科技七巨头估值已跌至十年最低，"杀估值"进程很大程度接近尾声。AI资本开支周期料仍延续，令科技股重获关注，但科技板块主导市场回报的时代已成过去。
summary.zh_hant: 摩根大通研報指，在歷經長達數月的估值壓縮後，美股科技股「最艱難的階段或已過去」，科技七巨頭估值已跌至十年最低，「殺估值」進程很大程度接近尾聲。AI資本開支周期料仍延續，令科技股重獲關注，但科技板塊主導市場回報的時代已成過去。

summary.en: Tennessee’s prisons commissioner is resigning after a botched lethal-injection execution attempt left death-row inmate Christa Pike unconscious on a ventilator. The failed execution triggered a political storm over the state’s death-penalty procedures.
summary.zh_hant: 美國田納西州注射死刑執行失敗，死囚Christa Pike至今昏迷，需用呼吸機維持，州懲教部門負責人宣布請辭；事件引發當地對死刑執行程序的風波。
summary.zh_hans: 美国田纳西州注射死刑执行失败，死囚Christa Pike至今昏迷，需用呼吸机维持，州惩教部门负责人宣布请辞；事件引发当地对死刑执行程序的风波。

title.en: Beacon Peak flat on Beacon Hill burglarized; HK$800,000 in jewelry and cash stolen

title.zh_hans: 毕架山Beacon Peak单位遭爆窃 男户主失约80万元珠宝现金

summary.en: A flat at Beacon Peak, No. 9 Beacon Hill Road, was burglarized. A 28-year-old male resident reported losing about HK$700,000 in jewelry and HK$100,000 in cash. No arrests have been made and police are investigating.
summary.zh_hant: 畢架山道9號Beacon Peak一個單位遭爆竊，28歲男戶主報稱損失約70萬元珠寶首飾及10萬元現金；暫未有人被捕，警方正調查。
summary.zh_hans: 毕架山道9号Beacon Peak一个单位遭爆窃，28岁男户主报称损失约70万元珠宝首饰及10万元现金；暂未有人被捕，警方正调查。

summary.en: The Nagoya Asian Games close today. Hong Kong sits ninth on the medal table with 11 gold, 19 silver and 24 bronze, and three Hong Kong equestrian riders compete in the jumping final this morning.
summary.zh_hant: 名古屋亞運會今日閉幕，港隊於獎牌榜排第九，共得11金19銀24銅；三名港隊馬術代表今日早上出戰場地障礙賽決賽。

title.en: One Stanley rebar issue: developer vows rigorous follow-up after Buildings Department findings
title.zh_hant: One Stanley鋼筋質量事件 建灝地產深夜回應：高度重視、嚴肅跟進
title.zh_hans: One Stanley钢筋质量事件 建灏地产深夜回应：高度重视、严肃跟进

summary.en: After the Buildings Department found steel-rebar configuration inconsistent with approved plans at the luxury Stanley project One Stanley, developer K&K (建灝地產) responded late at night, saying it takes the matter highly seriously and will follow it up rigorously. The department earlier warned that professionals or the contractor involved could face prosecution if violations are confirmed.
summary.zh_hant: 屋宇署早前揭發赤柱豪宅項目One Stanley部分獨立屋鋼筋配置與批准圖則不符，發展商建灝地產深夜發表聲明，指對事件高度重視，會嚴肅跟進。屋宇署早前指出，若證實專業人士或承建商違規，可提出檢控。
summary.zh_hans: 屋宇署早前揭发赤柱豪宅项目One Stanley部分独立屋钢筋配置与批准图则不符，发展商建灏地产深夜发表声明，指对事件高度重视，会严肃跟进。屋宇署早前指出，若证实专业人士或承建商违规，可提出检控。

title.en: MIRROR’s Stanley Yau to wed in Southeast Asia this month; band’s first married member
title.zh_hant: 邱士縉月底飛東南亞結婚 成MIRROR首位人夫 雪山唯美婚照曝光

summary.en: MIRROR member Stanley Yau announced he will fly to Southeast Asia with girlfriend Alina to hold their wedding at the end of the month, revealing romantic wedding photos taken in snowy mountains. His bandmates are expected to fly over to witness the ceremony, making him MIRROR’s first married member.
summary.zh_hant: MIRROR成員邱士縉宣布本月底與女友Alina飛往東南亞舉行婚禮，雪山唯美婚照曝光；據悉MIRROR眾兄弟將齊飛當地見證，他將成為MIRROR首位「人夫」。
summary.zh_hans: MIRROR成员邱士缙宣布本月底与女友Alina飞往东南亚举行婚礼，雪山唯美婚照曝光；据悉MIRROR众兄弟将齐飞当地见证，他将成为MIRROR首位「人夫」。

summary.en: China’s Shang Juncheng lost 0-2 in straight sets to Germany’s Alexander Zverev in the men’s singles second round of the China Open in Beijing on October 3, exiting the tournament.
summary.zh_hant: 中國球手商竣程於北京舉行的中國網球公開賽男單次圈，以0比2直落兩盤不敵德國球手施華利夫，止步第二圈。
